verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Solstice can to an unrecognisable orange sliver at the bottom edge, which loses the key product image. Its attribution is set larger and bolder than the quote, so the hierarchy is inverted, and the dark circle runs behind the attribution text. B keeps the can intact, but it floats half on the circle's edge rather than sitting inside it, and the logo is moved to the top right. B's quote is also small, with an attribution nearly the same size, and a cramped quote/attribution block next to an empty lower-left area.
